claim_one_line: THE OBJECT-S OWN SPECTRAL VALUE IS NOT LOW-DEGREE ALGEBRAIC: THE VALUE LAYER-S FIRST INFORMATIVE NULL. Prereg 107ae00f sealed AND PUSHED before compute, declared prior OUTCOME B, and the prior held. P0: computes over m004-s own second Maass spectral parameter r at 25 dp (B922), which B922 states is NOT INHERITED from the parent Bianchi group, making it an OBJECT-LEVEL quantity -- the address B993 left open when it showed the trace-field route is class-level. WHY THIS TEST HAD NEVER REALLY BEEN RUN: B798-s law is that PSLQ exclusion power needs N ~ 1.43*d*log10(H) digits, and the programme-s earlier spectral test ran at EIGHT digits which B798 says excludes essentially nothing -- so the banked 51st-percentile-of-random-spectra result was ABSENCE OF EVIDENCE, NOT EVIDENCE OF ABSENCE, and nobody had joined that fact to the null. B922-s 25 digits change the envelope to d<=8 at H<=1e2, d<=5 at 1e3, d<=3 at 1e5, d<=2 at 1e7, where at 8 digits it was d<=2 at H<=1e2, i.e. nothing. THE CONTROLS RAN FIRST AND BOTH PASSED: POSITIVE, the instrument must FIND degree-2 algebraics and did -- phi as x^6(x^2-x-1) and sqrt5 as x(x^2-5); NEGATIVE, it must find NOTHING on transcendentals and did -- pi and e return nothing across the whole envelope. So the instrument has POWER IN BOTH DIRECTIONS and every result is informative. THE CELLS, with r = 4.900085373062521301479576 and lambda = 25.01083666330126855876589: cell A (r over Q) NO RELATION at any envelope row; cell B (lambda over Q) NO RELATION; cell C (r over the object-s own fields phi, sqrt5, sqrt3) NO RELATION at any height; cell D (r against Vol(4_1) and pi) NO RELATION at any height. VERDICT: the object-s own spectral value is NOT algebraic of degree <=8 with height <=1e2, nor <=5 at 1e3, <=3 at 1e5, <=2 at 1e7, and carries NO low-height linear relation with phi, sqrt5, sqrt3, Vol(4_1) or pi. THIS IS THE VALUE LAYER-S FIRST INFORMATIVE NULL, every previous one including the 51st-percentile spectral test having been run below the power threshold and excluded nothing. SCOPE STATED EXACTLY: this excludes what 25 digits support and NOTHING MORE, so a relation of degree 9+ or height above the row-s bound is UNTOUCHED, and BSV parity needs 100 digits (B798) on an instrument 4-5 orders costlier; it is a fact about THE OBJECT, NOT ABOUT PHYSICS, with no SM quantity involved and none claimed, Gate 5 untouched; and had a relation fired it would have been a MATHEMATICAL result, the first object-specific NUMBER the programme produced, and STILL NOT TIER 2 -- the prereg said so before the run. WHAT IT CHANGES: the earlier spectral null can now be stated honestly, since it was not evidence and this is, so the programme can say for the first time that an OBJECT-LEVEL value was tested by an instrument with DEMONSTRATED POWER IN BOTH DIRECTIONS and came back negative within a stated envelope. And it prices the next step exactly: the only way to extend is MORE DIGITS, 100 for BSV parity on an instrument B798 already costed -- THE VALUE LAYER-S BOTTLENECK, NOW MEASURED RATHER THAN FELT. CORRECTION, SAME DAY: CELL D PARTLY DUPLICATED B922. B922-s own FINDINGS section on independent spot-checks already ran the parked-H4 axis at 26 dps -- r and lambda against the BTZ entropy value log((5+sqrt21)/2), Vol(4_1), pi^2, zeta(3), log phi, sqrt21 -- and reported CLEAN with coefficients <= 1e4. This seat-s P3 grepped CLAIM LINES, NOT FINDINGS, so cell D-s Vol(4_1) and pi tests are a RE-RUN, not new: the EIGHTH instance today of the same failure and the first where the protocol-s P3 was executed and still missed it, because it read the wrong surface. WHAT SURVIVES AS NEW: cells A and B test r and lambda as ALGEBRAIC NUMBERS over Q (integer relations among powers), where B922 tested them against a CONSTANT BASIS and not for algebraicity; cell C tests r against phi, sqrt5, sqrt3 in the pairwise basis, where B922 tested log phi as a constant rather than Q(phi)-membership; and above all THE ENVELOPE AND THE CONTROLS, since B922-s run states coefficients <= 1e4 with no degree/height envelope derived from B798-s law and no positive/negative control reported, whereas B1006 supplies both (phi and sqrt5 FOUND, pi and e NOT) so the null is DEMONSTRABLY POWERED rather than assumed so. B922 also already framed the conclusion correctly, which this seat should have quoted rather than rediscovered: the first real data point on the campaign-s central question, pointing where the literature prior expects -- no low-height algebraicity -- and explicitly NOT the campaign falsifier, which is the 100-digit box. HONEST STANDING: B1006 strengthens B922-s datum with an envelope and controls, and duplicates one of its axes.
